summary: Customer requests to withdraw fixed deposit and inquires about interest.

intents.keywords: I want to withdraw my fixed deposit yearly, ... does that work?

issues.issue: Customer wants to withdraw fixed deposit.

intents.actions of agent: Agent offered assistance and asked for the account number.
intents.resolution: Agent initiated the withdrawal process after calculating the penalty.

intents.keywords: Will I lose all the interest?

issues.issue: Customer is concerned about losing interest on premature withdrawal.

intents.actions of agent: Agent explained about reduced interest rate on premature withdrawal and offered to calculate the exact amount.
intents.resolution: Agent informed the customer about the reduced interest rate.
